A wooden card catalog and rows of library books are visible in the softly focused background. No computers, phones, tablets or digital devices. The scene must communicate the real work of finding information, reading books and copying notes by hand, not simply posing in a library.

Landscape 16:9 composition with no borders, no captions or typography overlays, no watermarks. Incidental book and notebook text small and unobtrusive; do not invent conspicuous legible nonsense. Create a realistic editorial photograph-like scene of a high-school student doing web-search research, evaluating source material and collecting useful facts. One student in ordinary navy casual clothing at a tidy wooden desk, seen over their shoulder at a three-quarter angle, with their profile and both hands naturally visible. A large desktop monitor clearly shows an ordinary web browser with multiple open tabs, a clean research article on one side, and a simple notes document on the other. One hand uses the mouse while the student compares the web article with a printed research page held by the other hand. The visual should immediately communicate opening tabs, judging sources, and gathering useful information; NOT an AI conversation, not social media, not coding or gaming. Browser content minimal and believable: optional small headings "Research" and "Notes", brief realistic text about a school research topic such as urban trees, a relevant small photograph, generous white space. No conspicuous gibberish, no visible brand names or recognizable software logos.
Natural warm daylight, believable home or school study setting, navy/teal and warm cream tones, realistic proportions and textured materials. Mature candid photographic realism, not a cartoon, anime or illustration. Calm editorial composition matching a companion photograph of a navy-clothed student researching printed books in a warm library. A single coherent scene, no collage. Keep the monitor, research page and hands within the central 90% safe area; screen large enough to understand at 1280x720. No captions, decorative typography, borders, logos or watermarks.
